description: The current user's swaps with friends: waiting_for_you (proposed to the user: approve or decline with answer_swap), waiting_for_friend (proposed by the user: they may withdraw it), and answered in the last 30 days. Each swap: you_give and you_receive with cards, value in `currency` (default USD) and lines. Disclosure duties: name every deck of the user's a copy they give breaks (lines[].breaks_decks), and on an open swap every claim the yes would release (lines[].would_release). The friend's deck names are never shown. An open swap past expires_at reads expired.

currency.description: Display currency. USD/EUR come from Scryfall; CHF is always EUR × the stored ECB rate. A response that carries `rate_missing` could not price in CHF at all: tell the user that, not that the cards have no price.

name: my_swaps

answered.description: Approved, declined, withdrawn or expired, the last 30 days

direction.description: proposed: the user proposed it; received: it waits for the user's answer

expires_at.description: An open swap after this reads expired and can no longer be approved

claimed.description: Received copies the user's ticked decks claimed

not_claimed.description: A tick that could not be kept at the yes: the deck no longer missed the card, or is past the plan

released.description: Claims the yes released from the user's decks

result.description: What an approved swap did to the user's side; null until approved

with.description: The friend's handle ("@name"); null when they have since given it up

add_to.description: The user's own tick: the deck of theirs that claims these copies on the yes

breaks_decks.description: The user's own decks this copy's trade breaks: name each one. Always empty on the friend's copies, whose decks stay theirs

decks_missing.description: A swap waiting for the user's yes: the user's decks that miss this card, which answer_swap's add_to may name. Ask; never tick one for them

image_uri.description: The card's picture on Scryfall, to show as it is; null when the catalogue has none

is_altered.description: Altered copies: say so, the receiver gets them as they are

is_signed.description: Signed copies: say so, the receiver gets them as they are

lang.description: Scryfall's language code of these copies

scryfall_url.description: The card's page on Scryfall: link the card's name to it

unit_price.description: Per copy in `currency`; null when no price is known (counted as zero)

would_release.description: Open swaps, the user's own copies: the claims the yes releases now, by deck. Name each one before the user approves

unpriced_cards.description: Copies with no known price, left out of value: say so
